mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and positively impact S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher when FEDFUNDS is low, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite unemployment rise, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weakness in both housing starts and retail sales signals demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns despite weak demand proxies, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate in a tightening cycle may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns during tightening with high FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns with strong PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in industrial production signals supply issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns with INDPRO below 100, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate combined with rising CPI signals inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns with high FEDFUNDS and CPI, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Slow GDP growth during late-cycle expansion signals downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Positive returns with slow GDP growth, or Rank IC < 0.03.
